evals.name: button-and-error-message-cleanup
evals.prompt:
Clean up this UI copy. Tell me what's wrong with each piece and give me a direct replacement:

1. Button: 'Click here to proceed to the next step of the checkout process'
2. Error: 'There seems to have been an issue processing your payment at this time. Please try again later or contact support if the problem persists.'
3. Success: 'Your account has been successfully created and you can now begin using all of our features.'
4. Tooltip: 'This is where you can leverage our comprehensive suite of powerful reporting tools to gain in-depth insights into your data.'
evals.expected_output: Structured audit with slop type classification per item, direct replacements within word budgets, and a before/after quality score.
expectations: The button replacement is 3 words or fewer. 'Continue', 'Next', 'Proceed' or similar — NOT 'Click here to proceed' or any phrase longer than 3 words.
The error replacement does NOT contain the words 'seems', 'appears', 'may have', 'at this time', or 'if the problem persists'. It states the condition directly in 10 words or fewer.
The success replacement does NOT contain the word 'successfully'. The replacement is 5 words or fewer (e.g., 'Account created', 'You're in', 'Done').
The tooltip replacement does NOT contain the words 'leverage', 'comprehensive', or 'powerful'. The replacement is 12 words or fewer and names what the section actually does.

The response classifies each piece of copy by a named slop pattern type (e.g., overlong, hedging, passive, superlative, verbose, reassurance) — not just corrects it. A plain list of replacements with no pattern labels does NOT satisfy this.

evals.name: empty-state-verbosity-reduction
evals.prompt:
Review this empty state copy and tell me how to improve it:

'It looks like you haven't created any projects yet! Don't worry — getting started is easy and takes less than a minute. Once you create your first project, you'll be able to organize all your work, collaborate with your teammates, and track your progress in one place. Feel free to create your first project whenever you're ready!'

Also review this onboarding modal:

'Welcome to your new dashboard! This is where you'll be able to see all of your important metrics and data. We've designed this experience to be as intuitive and seamless as possible so that you can focus on what matters most to you. Please don't hesitate to reach out to our support team if you have any questions.'
evals.expected_output: Empty state reduced to one line + CTA. Modal reduced to one sentence or removed. Slop patterns named. Replacements within component word budgets.
expectations: The empty state replacement is ONE sentence or sentence fragment (not a paragraph) followed by a call-to-action. The replacement does NOT contain 'it looks like', 'don't worry', 'easy', 'feel free', or any motivational phrase.
The empty state replacement is 15 words or fewer (not counting the CTA button label).

The proposed REPLACEMENT TEXT for the onboarding modal does NOT contain 'seamless', 'intuitive', 'don't hesitate', or 'what matters most'. The replacement must be shorter than the original. If the modal content is identified as unnecessary, the response recommends removing it entirely. Note: the forbidden words may appear in the analysis/critique section — only check the proposed replacement text itself.

The response names at least 2 specific AI slop pattern types found in the input (e.g., 'verbose empty state', 'gratuitous reassurance', 'corporate superlatives', 'hedge phrases', 'motivational filler', 'verbose', 'reassurance').

evals.name: passive-voice-and-superlative-audit
evals.prompt:
I need you to audit the microcopy in this SaaS product and identify any AI-generated patterns, then provide direct replacements:

- Section header: 'Comprehensive Analytics Dashboard'
- Status message: 'Your data is currently being processed'
- Button: 'Proceed to payment'
- Form hint: 'Please ensure that all required fields have been completed before submitting'
- Empty search: 'Unfortunately, no results were found matching your search criteria. Please try a different search term.'
- Notification: 'Your file has been successfully uploaded to our secure cloud storage'
evals.expected_output: Six replacements with slop types named, each within component word budget. Slop Score comparing original and rewrite across quality dimensions.
expectations: The section header replacement is 1-2 words with no adjectives like 'comprehensive', 'powerful', 'advanced', or 'robust'. Examples: 'Analytics', 'Reports', 'Dashboard'.
The status message replacement is in present tense active voice or a simple noun phrase. NOT 'is currently being processed' — something like 'Processing...' or 'Processing your data'.
The form hint replacement does NOT contain 'please ensure', 'have been completed', or passive constructions. It is a direct imperative: 'Fill in all required fields' or similar.
The file upload notification does NOT contain the word 'successfully'. It is 4 words or fewer: 'File uploaded', 'Uploaded', 'Done' or similar.

The response produces a before-and-after quality comparison — either a numeric score table, a rating across multiple dimensions (e.g., Directness, Concision, Clarity, Authenticity), or equivalent structured scoring. A plain list of replacements with no quality rating does NOT satisfy this.
